component.name: Keylatch
component.summary: Secure credential gateway for AI coding tools

description.p: Keylatch is a secure credential gateway that controls how AI coding tools like Claude Code and Copilot access your API keys and secrets. It provides per-request approval workflows, audit logs, and policy enforcement so you stay in control of your credentials.

ul.li: Per-request credential approval with tray notifications
Tamper-evident audit log of every credential access
Policy engine: allow/deny by tool, provider, or action
HMAC-authenticated local IPC — no cloud required

description.p: Initial desktop release with Tauri shell and Go sidecar.
